Name: qryProviderServiceStatistics
Sql:
SELECT p.ProviderID, p.ProviderName, csp.FiscalYear, sub.UniqueClientCount AS Clients, Sum(csp.HoursPerWeek * 52) AS Hours, Sum(csp.AnnualEstCost) AS TotalCost, FormatCurrency (Sum(csp.AnnualEstCost) / sub.UniqueClientCount) AS AvgPerClient
FROM (tblProviders AS p INNER JOIN (tblProviderServiceCatalog AS psc INNER JOIN tblClientServicePlan AS csp ON psc.ProviderServiceCatalogID = csp.ProviderServiceCatalogID) ON p.ProviderID = psc.ProviderID) INNER JOIN (SELECT Dist.ProviderID, Count(Dist.ClientID) AS UniqueClientCount FROM (SELECT DISTINCT psc2.ProviderID, csn2.ClientID FROM tblProviderServiceCatalog AS psc2 INNER JOIN (tblClientServicePlan AS csp2 INNER JOIN tblClientServiceNeeds AS csn2 ON csp2.ClientServiceNeedID = csn2.ClientServiceNeedID) ON psc2.ProviderServiceCatalogID = csp2.ProviderServiceCatalogID WHERE csp2.Status <> 'Cancelled')  AS Dist GROUP BY Dist.ProviderID)  AS sub ON p.ProviderID = sub.ProviderID
WHERE csp.Status <> 'Cancelled'
GROUP BY p.ProviderID, p.ProviderName, csp.FiscalYear, sub.UniqueClientCount;
